title: Generate in the Chart, Not on the Boundary: Function-Symbol Grounding for Hard Constraints in LTN-GANs
abstract: arXiv:2608.21605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Logic Tensor Network-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Networks (LTN-GANs) inject background knowledge by grounding each logical axiom as a predicate and training the generator to raise its satisfaction, a fuzzy truth value in $[0,1]$. Previous LTN-GAN work grounded every constraint this way, at the predicate level, and improved constraint satisfaction. A predicate, however, only scores a sample, so it cannot embed hard structural constraints, rules such as orderings, positivity, and definitional identities that must hold in every generated sample. In this work, we investigate grounding each axiom as a function symbol inside the LTN framework. We compare against the state-of-the-art alternative, a constraint layer that clamps each violating sample onto the feasible boundary and so produces outputs that are always valid. translated_title: 在图表内生成，而非边界上：LTN-GAN中硬约束的函数符号接地
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21605v1 公告类型：新 摘要：逻辑张量网络增强生成对抗网络（LTN-GANs）通过将每个逻辑公理接地为谓词，并训练生成器提高其满足度（一个在$[0,1]$范围内的模糊真值），来注入背景知识。以往的LTN-GAN工作以这种方式在谓词级别接地所有约束，并改善了约束满足。然而，谓词仅对样本进行评分，无法嵌入硬性结构约束，如排序、正性和定义恒等式等必须在每个生成样本中成立的规则。在本工作中，我们研究了在LTN框架内将每个公理接地为函数符号的方法。我们与最先进的替代方案——一个约束层，将每个违规样本夹紧到可行边界上，从而产生始终有效的输出——进行了比较。我们的研究表明，有效样本并不总是逼真的样本。不等式不仅仅是满足或违反的问题。
tldr: 本文提出在LTN-GAN中将硬约束接地为函数符号而非谓词，以生成满足结构规则且逼真的样本，挑战了仅靠边界夹紧保证有效性的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes grounding hard constraints as function symbols in LTN-GANs to generate realistic samples that satisfy structural rules, challenging boundary-clamping approaches that ensure validity but not realism.
